universe.note: the m = 5 open set of coverage map r5. C5 changes no coverage map unless a cell is formally adopted.

baseline.authority: coverage map r5 and the frozen K5-B direct clause as consumed at the C4 head

baseline.note: every improvement percentage in C5 is measured against THIS baseline unless another is named explicitly

deterministic_family_under_test.name: the K5-B midpoint-to-cell transport family
deterministic_family_under_test.definition: every bound on max_{e in cell} g(e) derivable from exactly two certified inputs: (i) an upper bound g_hi on g(e0), and (ii) a whole-cell enclosure [H_lo, H_hi] of R'' -- given that the cell lies in e > 0 and g'(e) = -e R''(e)
covers: the frozen clause's rho * x_hi * M
any other transport using only those two inputs
does_not_cover: anything that improves the R'' enclosure (that is the atom-constant / surrogate / rho work)
a transport that consumes a third certified input, e.g. a midpoint enclosure of R'' or any bound on R'''

compute_policy.remote_hosts_contacted: none. AWS SR/PS1 must not be contacted; no compute worker may be used.
compute_policy.permitted: exact rational arithmetic on committed artifacts; deterministic re-evaluation of the frozen consumers at chosen inputs; local mutation and manufactured tests; clearly-labelled local diagnostics
forbidden: new CUSUM or SR/PS1 scientific addresses
compute_policy.refusal: a route needing a forbidden operation is INADMISSIBLE for C5 whatever its gain, and is recorded in the ledger as a future route rather than pursued

closure_criterion: a cell CLOSES iff Gamma < 0 under the selected clause, evaluated exactly in rationals

material_tightening_test.metric: the fall in the gap above 1 of the M-reduction factor still needed, against the baseline above
material_tightening_test.inherited_from: the C2 gate's 20% gap-fall threshold, carried unchanged through C3
material_tightening_test.note: deliberately inherited rather than chosen, so that C5 cannot set a bar its own known result would clear

exhaustion_criterion.statement: a deterministic family is EXHAUSTED only if the campaign exhibits an ADMISSIBLE member of the family's input set that ATTAINS the proposed bound, so that no member can do better
exhaustion_criterion.not_sufficient: showing that the campaign's own implementation cannot improve further
exhaustion_criterion.scope_rule: an exhaustion verdict must name the exact family, the exact certified inputs it is relative to, and the cells and m it applies to; a family exhaustion is never deterministic exhaustion of the cell

classification.INVALID: a premise of the selected theorem is unsatisfied, a domain is violated, or a guard refuses
classification.FULL_CLOSURE: every cell of the universe closes
classification.PARTIAL_CLOSURE: at least one previously open cell closes
classification.MATERIAL_TIGHTENING: no new closure, but every still-open cell's gap falls by at least the threshold
classification.MARGINAL: a certified tightening that does not reach the threshold on every still-open cell
classification.exhaustion_is_separate: the exhaustion verdict is recorded in its own field, EXHAUSTED / NOT_EXHAUSTED, against the exhaustion_criterion above, and does NOT change the primary class

any_class: C5 adopts no cell and creates no coverage map revision unless the independent adjudicator formally adopts a cell as CLOSED
